name: vulcanus-fulgora-integration
title: Vulcanus ↔ Fulgora: Cross-Planet Industrial Integration
author: Liam Stannard
description: Adds a two-way industrial loop between Vulcanus and Fulgora: Fulgora recovers and refines its scrap using imported Vulcanus Calcite, and its refined Catalyst Rod unlocks a Vulcanus-only lava process. The chain terminates in a space platform power source that fills the gap between solar and Aquilo-locked fusion. See design/vulcanus-fulgora.md for the full design doc.
